related.title: 深空地面站通訊工程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學轉矩上限 0.01 N m 時 120 s 案例通過，但仍須動量和穩定後指向誤差驗證。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: With a 0.01 N m teaching limit, 120 s passes torque, pending momentum and settled-pointing checks. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 把接收時窗取聯集後計算唯一資料容量，避免重疊時段重複計帳。
related.differenceEn: Calculate unique data capacity from the union of contact windows without double-counting overlap.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學單軸慣量 12 kg m²、轉角 90°=π/2 rad、總時間 60 s。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：τ=12×4×(π/2)/60²。 結果約 0.020944 N m。對稱加減速總角度 θ、總時間 T 時 α=4θ/T²，τ=Iα；忽略耦合、摩擦及柔性模態。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學兩站窗口為 0–30 和 20–50 min，唯一資料率 2 Mbit/s，不含封包負擔。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：V=(30+30−10)×60×2/8。 結果約 750 MB。固定唯一資料率下容量=聯集時間×資料率；重複接收同一資料不增加唯一容量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching single-axis inertia is 12 kg m², angle 90°=π/2 rad and total time 60 s. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: τ=12×4×(π/2)/60². Result ≈ 0.020944 N m. For symmetric acceleration/deceleration, α=4θ/T² and torque τ=Iα, excluding coupling, friction and flexible modes.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching windows are 0–30 and 20–50 min at a unique rate of 2 Mbit/s, excluding packet overhead. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: V=(30+30−10)×60×2/8. Result ≈ 750 MB. At fixed unique-data rate, capacity=union time×rate; duplicate reception does not add unique capacity.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

由週期式隔離 r，先求地心半徑後減地球半徑，檢查 km³/s² 的單位。

Isolate r, calculate geocentric radius and then subtract Earth radius; check km³/s² units.
